description: This file defines the 'PersonQuery' class, which provides various methods to construct complex search predicates for querying Person entities in a Hibernate Search context, including name-based, attribute-based, and filtered queries, primarily used for implementing flexible person search functionality within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: PersonQuery
classes.description: Provides methods to build search predicates for person-related queries including name, attribute, and filters.

methods.name: getPatientNameQuery
methods.description: Constructs a search predicate for patients based on name query, including or excluding voided records.

methods.name: getPersonNameQueryWithOrParser
methods.description: Creates a name query predicate with OR parser enabled, for more flexible search criteria.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameSearchOnThreeNames
methods.description: Builds a soundex-based search predicate for persons with three name parts (given, middle, family).

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameSearchOnTwoNames
methods.description: Builds a soundex-based search predicate for persons with two name parts.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameSearchOnNNames
methods.description: Builds a soundex-based search predicate for multiple name parts.

methods.name: getSoundexPersonNameQuery
methods.description: Creates a soundex-based name search predicate for given, middle, and family names.

methods.name: getPersonNameQuery
methods.description: Private helper to create a name query predicate with flexible match modes and filters.

methods.name: newPersonNameSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs the actual predicate for a name search with specified fields, query string, and options.

methods.name: applyPersonFilters
methods.description: Applies common person filters like voided status, gender, birth year, and deceased status to the predicate.

methods.name: getPatientAttributeQuery
methods.description: Constructs attribute-based person search queries including voided filtering.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeQueryWithOrParser
methods.description: Creates an attribute query with OR parser enabled.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeQuery
methods.description: Private helper for building attribute-based search predicates with filters.
